mentions.name: Email-to-Calendar Feed for Kindergarten Emails
mentions.description: This service converts emails, including attachments, from the multitude of services related to the user's kindergartener into a calendar feed, automatically surfacing school-related events on the calendar.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building an email-to-calendar-feed service for all the mails from the multitude of services and attachments that I get related to my kindergartener.
